title: The Wee Free Men
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: Young Tiffany Aching, who dreams of being a witch, must rescue her little brother from the Queen of the Fairies. Her only allies are the Nac Mac Feegle, a band of tiny, loud blue men.
readIf: you like funny, sharp fantasy with a clever young heroine.
skipIf: you want serious fantasy without jokes and Scots-accented comic relief.
